title: Nginx upstream timeout causing 504 Gateway Timeout storm
symptoms: Nginx error logs flooded with: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream. 504 error rate reached 35%. All upstream app servers showing healthy in health checks but response times at 45s.
root_cause: A background batch job consuming 100% CPU on all app server cores was starving the web workers. Nginx proxy_read_timeout was set to 30s but app processing was taking 45s. The health checks only verified TCP connectivity, not actual response time.
fix_applied: 1. Killed the runaway batch job. 2. Moved batch processing to dedicated worker nodes with CPU limits. 3. Increased proxy_read_timeout to 60s as interim fix. 4. Implemented health checks with actual endpoint response validation. 5. Added CPU-based circuit breaker.
